# sleep_sleeper (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the datasource. This can be any random string value since this provider stores no information

### Optional

- `read_sleep` (Number) The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from ReadData. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.
- `string_in` (String) An optional field that will be used to be returned by the data source in the `string_out` attribute

### Read-Only

- `string_out` (String) Value that will be generated by the data source. It uses the information passed into `string_in` or if that is missing, it will use the value of the `id` attribute
